time-tracker.name: timer_start
time-tracker.description: Start tracking time on a project. Only one timer runs at a time: starting a new one stops and logs the previous one.

time-tracker.name: timer_stop
time-tracker.description: Stop the running timer and log it as a time entry. Returns the duration and the entry id.

time-tracker.name: timer_status
time-tracker.description: Show the running timer, how long it has been running, and today's total so far.

time-tracker.name: entry_add
time-tracker.description: Log time you already worked. Give start plus either end or minutes.

time-tracker.name: entry_list
time-tracker.description: List logged time entries as a compact table. Free tier shows the last 7 days.

time-tracker.name: entry_delete
time-tracker.description: Delete one time entry by id.

time-tracker.name: entry_edit
time-tracker.description: Change fields of an existing entry. Only the fields you pass are changed.

time-tracker.name: project_set_rate
time-tracker.description: Set the hourly rate used to turn tracked hours into money for a project.

time-tracker.name: report
time-tracker.description: Total tracked hours and money for a period, grouped by project, day, task or tag. Free tier covers the last 7 days.

time-tracker.name: export_csv
time-tracker.description: Write time entries to a CSV file you can hand to a bookkeeper or import into a spreadsheet. Free tier exports the last 7 days.

time-tracker.name: invoice_summary
time-tracker.description: Turn tracked time into invoice line items for one project: hours, rate, amount per task, plus the total.

price-tracker.name: price_check
price-tracker.description: Fetch a product page right now and report its price, currency and title, plus the change against the last price stored for that URL. Does not create a watch.

price-tracker.name: watch_add
price-tracker.description: Start tracking a product page. Fetches it once and stores the first observation. Optionally set a target price to be alerted about.

price-tracker.name: watch_list
price-tracker.description: Show every tracked item with its current price, target and last check time.

price-tracker.name: watch_remove
price-tracker.description: Stop tracking an item, by watch id or by URL. Its history is deleted.

price-tracker.name: watch_refresh
price-tracker.description: Re-fetch one watch or every watch, append the new observations and show current, previous, min, max, change % and target hits.

price-tracker.name: price_history
price-tracker.description: List the stored observations for one watch, newest last. Free shows the last 10.

price-tracker.name: price_add_manual
price-tracker.description: Store a price you read yourself, for shops that block automated requests. Creates the watch if it does not exist yet.

price-tracker.name: alerts_pending
price-tracker.description: Show watches whose latest price is at or below the target, or which dropped ${DROP_ALERT_PCT}% or more against the previous observation.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_info
spreadsheet.description: Open an xlsx or csv file and describe it: sheet names, size, guessed header row, per-column type, sample values and empty counts. Start here before reading or querying.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_read
spreadsheet.description: Read rows from a sheet as a text table, JSON records or CSV. Use limit/offset to page through big files, or range for an A1 block like B2:F40.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_query
spreadsheet.description: Filter, pick columns and sort rows without writing any code. where uses a small safe expression language: comparisons = != > >= < <= plus contains / startswith / endswith, combined with AND, OR, NOT and parentheses.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_stats
spreadsheet.description: Per-column count, empty count, distinct values, min, max, sum, mean and median. Numbers are parsed from currency and percent text too.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_find
spreadsheet.description: Search every cell for text (case insensitive) and return cell addresses with a preview of the row it is on.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_write
spreadsheet.description: Write rows to a spreadsheet. rows may be objects (keys become headers) or arrays (first array is the header row).

spreadsheet.name: sheet_add_column
spreadsheet.description: Convert a sheet to csv, xlsx or json. Writes a new file next to the source unless out_path is given.

invoice.name: business_set
invoice.description: Store the issuer profile printed at the top of every invoice: your name, address, VAT id, bank details and defaults (currency, tax rate, payment terms, invoice number prefix). Call this once before creating invoices.

invoice.name: client_add
invoice.description: Store a client so invoices can refer to them by name. Re-adding the same name updates the stored details.

invoice.name: client_list
invoice.description: List every stored client with their id, address, email and VAT id.

invoice.name: invoice_create
invoice.description: Create an invoice for a client from a list of items. Allocates the next invoice number (never reused), computes subtotal, discount, tax lines per rate and the total. Amounts are held as integer minor units; every line is

invoice.name: invoice_from_hours
invoice.description: Shortcut for the common case: bill one client for N hours at an hourly rate. Creates a single-line invoice.

invoice.name: invoice_list
invoice.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by status (unpaid, paid, partial), client, and an issue-date range.

invoice.name: invoice_get
invoice.description: Return the full stored record for one invoice number, including every line and tax breakdown.

invoice.name: invoice_mark_paid
invoice.description: Record a payment. Without an amount the invoice is marked fully paid; a smaller amount marks it partial and reports the remaining balance.

invoice.name: invoice_pdf
invoice.description: Render an invoice as an A4 PDF you can send: issuer block, client block, dates, item table with wrapped descriptions, subtotal, discount, tax lines per rate, total, payment details and notes. Returns the file path.

invoice.name: overdue_report
invoice.description: List every unpaid or partly paid invoice past its due date with days overdue, plus outstanding totals per currency. Pro.
